description: cosy is published to crates.io, so this is configured as a library: it keeps the semver ranges in Cargo.toml (Renovate's default cargo 'replace' strategy only rewrites them on out-of-range/major bumps) rather than pinning, which would needlessly constrain downstream consumers.

packageRules.description: Batch and automerge non-major dev-dependency updates (CI gates the merge)
